name: What factors determine the cost of log home refinishing?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of log home refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to refinish a log home depends heavily on total square footage, building height, log condition, and the level of prep work required. Simply washing, hand-prepping, and applying a maintenance topcoat over sound stain costs significantly less than stripping multiple layers of failing, blackened finish down to bare timber. Additional cost drivers include repairing rotted wood logs, re-chinking failed joints, addressing high gable walls that require scaffolding, and remedying water damage. Having an experienced general contractor assess the structure on-site ensures all prep, caulking, and finish needs are itemized clearly before work starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on home size, wall height, log condition, the need to strip old finishes down to bare wood, and repairs for rotted logs or cracked chinking.
